pages.quiz:
ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #11
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 21
   C. 15.7
   D. 15

2. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 40

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 17
   C. 23
   D. 19

4. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 121
   C. 122
   D. 11

5. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 43

6. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 5
   C. 10
   D. 25

7. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 12x + 2

8. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

9. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 7

10. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 3
   C. 29
   D. 11

11. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 170
   C. 26
   D. 13

12. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 7

13. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 81

14. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

15. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 21
   C. 9
   D. 20

16. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 4
   C. 32
   D. 12

17. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31.7
   C. 31
   D. 37

18. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 10

19. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 3, 6, 9
   B. 1, 2, 3, 6
   C. 1, 6
   D. 2, 4, 6

20. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.6
   C. 19
   D. 19.7

21. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 2/2
   D. 1/4

22. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 88
   B. 19
   C. 22
   D. 38

23. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 37

24. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 49

25. Solve for x: x + 7 = 19. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 19
   C. 13
   D. 12

26. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 4
   C. 32
   D. 12

27. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 120
   C. 46
   D. 30

28. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 27.6
   C. 33
   D. 27

29. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 1
   C. 7
   D. 12

30. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 2
   D. 1

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
